messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — cost team flagged GPU spend is +32% MoM. I want to try a controlled spot/preemptible push for non-urgent training and some inference burst capacity. Thinking mixed-instance policy + launch template changes in Terraform. Thoughts?

Eric Patel: SGTM. we should do a canary ASG in one AZ first. low risk.

Jose Gonzalez: agree on canary. also need baked AMI with nvidia 535 + matching kernel so nodetools don't fail. Packer pipeline needs a new bake job.

Li Zhao: FYI, recent preemption rates in us-west-2a are ~4% for g5 when market is volatile. We need graceful interruption handling and fast re-schedule.

Tanya Brooks: +1 on interruption handling. we should deploy the node-termination-handler and set cluster-autoscaler tolerances. Also taint spot nodes so we can migrate critical pods to on-demand nodes.

Maya Chen: plan sketch: 1) Terraform change adds aws_launch_template (spot-friendly) + aws_autoscaling_group with mixed_instances_policy; 2) new AMI bake and image id variable; 3) tagging standardization (cost-center/team/env/stack); 4) canary ASG with 10% of target capacity in us-west-2b for 72h; 5) monitor interruption_rate and pod evictions; 6) rollback to dedicated pool on issues.

Eric Patel: For the TF snippet, propose using capacity-optimized allocation strategy and lifecycle hooks for spot interruption signal. Something like: 

```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "spot_gpu" {
  name_prefix   = "spot-gpu-"
  image_id      = var.ami_id
  instance_type = "m6i.large" # override in ASG overrides list
  tag_specifications {
    resource_type = "instance"
    tags = {
      Name = "${var.env}-spot-gpu"
      team = var.team
      cost-center = var.cost_center
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_spot_asg" {
  name                      = "${var.env}-gpu-spot"
  mixed_instances_policy {
    launch_template {
      launch_template_specification {
        launch_template_id = aws_launch_template.spot_gpu.id
        version            = "$Latest"
      }
    }
    instances_distribution {
      on_demand_base_capacity                  = 0
      on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity = 10
      spot_allocation_strategy                  = "capacity-optimized"
    }
    override { instance_type = "g5.xlarge" }
    override { instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge" }
    override { instance_type = "a10g.xlarge" }
  }
  min_size = var.min_size
  max_size = var.max_size
}
```

Jose Gonzalez: small nit: use weighted_capacity in overrides for heterogeneous GPU sizes. add `weighted_capacity` to the overrides block and tune autoscaler scalingPolicy accordingly.

Li Zhao: Also add `instance_market_options { market_type = "spot" }` in launch template and set `spot_instance_pools` if using spot fleet. For interruption handling: ensure the AMI has the AWS SSM agent + node-termination-handler installed and systemd unit enabled.

Tanya Brooks: kube-level: add node annotation `preemptible=true` and taint `spot=true:NoSchedule`. Update Helm chart for cluster-autoscaler with `--balance-similar-node-groups=false` and `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false`? Wait check flags. We'll draft exact values.

Maya Chen: good call. Also need to update our Terraform tagging module to include `billing:team`, `billing:project`, and `redwood:managed_by=terraform`. Operations wants consistent tags for cost allocation.

Eric Patel: Rollout strategy in PR: 
- Create new TF module `asg-spot-mixed` in infra repo.
- Open draft PR with changes limited to a feature flag var `enable_spot_mixed = false` default.
- QA: apply to dev account in us-west-2 (canary ASG only).
- After 72h, flip var to true for staging, monitor 1 week, then prod canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks.

Jose Gonzalez: For the AMI build: base on our current cudnn image, add `nvidia-driver-535`, `cuda-12.2`, docker runtime `nvidia-container-toolkit` and bake kernel-headers too. Tag AMI with GPU type and driver versions. Example: `redwood-ami-gpu-535-cuda12-20260201`.

Li Zhao: Observability: add `spot_preemption_events` to Prometheus and a Grafana dashboard. track `node_termination_handler_events_total`, `kube_pod_evictions_total`, and `ASG_replacements_per_hour`. Add alert if interruption rate > 7% for 4h.

Tanya Brooks: Don't forget network constraints: some zones have limited EFA or ENA capacities for certain instance types. Add instance type fallback list per AZ. Terraform variable `instance_type_fallbacks = {"us-west-2a" = ["g5.xlarge","g4dn.xlarge"], ...}`

Maya Chen: Exception handling: if preemption spikes, autoscaler should prefer on-demand fallback group. We'll add `on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity = 50` for production pool and set a policy to rebalance.

Eric Patel: Security note: AMIs must be scanned by Clair and approved before we flip feature flag. Add a pre-apply check in CI that confirms AMI ID is in approved image list in parameter store.

Jose Gonzalez: Terraform diff will be noisy; recommend splitting into 3 PRs: 1) tags + AMI variable plumbing, 2) launch template + ASG canary, 3) autoscaler/helm + node termination handler + dashboards.

Maya Chen: timeline? I can drive PR1 today, PR2 early next week. Who can own AMI bake? Jose?

Jose Gonzalez: I can start Packer bake tomorrow. ETA 48h.

Li Zhao: I'll prepare Grafana panels and Prom alerts.

Tanya Brooks: I'll draft Helm values for cluster-autoscaler and kube-node-termination-handler.

infra-bot: scheduled terraform plan job #527 queued for dev account (us-west-2).

deploy-bot: canary ASG created (dev): aws://us-west-2/us-west-2b/asg/rdw-spot-canary-01 - capacity 6

Maya Chen: Nice. When the canary is up let's run a controlled interruption test (simulate spot termination using `ec2-instance-action`) and validate drains + pod reschedules.

Eric Patel: Also run synthetic inference load to ensure latency isn't impacted when mixed GPUs come up. Use the perf harness (perf/inference/load_g5.yaml).

Tanya Brooks: reminder: add a kube-pdb for critical stateful sets so they don't get evicted all at once.

Jose Gonzalez: FYI during bake I had to pin kernel to 6.1.x to match nvidia module. Documenting in AMI build steps.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. I'll open PR1 and tag @Jose Gonzalez @Li Zhao @Tanya Brooks for review. We'll keep rollback simple: destroy spot ASG and remove `enable_spot_mixed` var.

Eric Patel: 👍 :rocket:

Tanya Brooks: :thumbsup:
